description: Signaleringskaart buisleidingen Visie Ruimte en Mobiliteit is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Signaleringskaart buisleidingen Visie Ruimte en Mobiliteit signaleert de buisleidingenstraten en buisleidingenstroken in de provincie Zuid-Holland. Dit zijn ruimtelijke reserveringen. In buisleidingstraten zijn geen andere functies dan buisleidingen mogelijk. In de leidingstroken wel, mits die voldoen aan de randvoorwaarden van de transportfunctie. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are infrastructuur, leidingen. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
